respStmt.name: Chu, Chen-Yu

publicationStmt.p: Research data projection. Consult the package rights statement for each layer. Source images are not included.

sourceDesc.p: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Français 3993, no. 102; three letter faces on Gallica canvases 161 and 162. Folio 148v is inferred from sequence. The crop review uses separately identified public source crops.

encodingDesc.p: Each seg is a provisional visual unit, not a proven cipher unit, letter, numeral or word. Unicode approximates appearance. Separate reading streams preserve differing segmentations. No plaintext is supplied. All streams are not-human-reviewed; the new-face streams have only finite local adjudication in a separate JSON file. This TEI is a minimal sequence projection; JSON retains all annotations.
